description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small white pedestal-like object with a cup-shaped cover sitting over it. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the base while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the cup-shaped cover as a right-hand object, lifts it straight up to reveal a round-topped piece underneath, then carries the cover to the right and sets it down, releasing it while the left hand lets go and pulls back.
